acceptance: Default producer builds and certifies exact schema 3; the currently deployed site verifies that output and continues serving production.
Explicit candidate schema-4 build contains docs-data and doc-contracts.json and passes producer verification; old consumer rejection is demonstrated, not called compatibility.
No schema-4 artifact is selected by normal publication/dispatch until docs-mig-site-bundle-schema4 is verified deployed; exact-set verification is not weakened.
Core PR merged, CI and oracle review green; current production unaffected.
Explicit genuine candidate4 and candidate5 builds at identical inputs verify with exact member sets; neither is normally published before its consumer.
context: Core producer side merged in PR #3445 without changing default emission: `site_inputs.py build --profile exact3|candidate4|candidate5` (exact3 default; publication workflow never passes a profile, pinned by a workflow test); `make site-inputs-candidate`; schema 4 = schema 3 members + docs-data + doc-contracts.json; schema 5 = schema 4 without docs/downloads; verify chooses the exact member set from manifest.schema, validates the new members against their JSON schemas, rejects extra docs-data entries; candidate builds refuse --certified-by and verify requires certified_by == 'candidate'. Verified: real builds at one commit (11/13/11 members) pass verify; develop's previous verifier rejects both candidates ('schema mismatch'); docs-data, doc-contracts.json and repo-files.json digests match across candidate4 and candidate5. NOT verified / remaining: the deployed site's TypeScript verifier (site repo) was not run against candidates; docs-data is emitted as a directory holding docs-data.json (site layout expectation unverified); whole-bundle digests of candidate4 vs candidate5 differ because the Explorer snapshot digest differs between builds. Item stays open for site-side consumer verification before any publication switch.
description:
Implement producer capability for exact schema-4 docs-data and doc-contracts.json members while keeping schema-3 publication as the default. Keep capability behind an explicit local/CI build selector, not enabled in the publication workflow. Update producer verification, JSON schemas, member digests, tests and necessary soundness declarations. The schema-3 member set must remain exactly unchanged. Land protected changes with oracle review. Scope: scripts/site_inputs.py, its tests, exporter wiring, CI routing and versioned schema definitions. Runtime schema-4 publication is explicitly re-homed to docs-mig-activate-schema4 after consumer deployment.
Also implement explicit local/CI candidate production AND verification for schema5 (same data as4, exact members omit docs/downloads). Normal published default remains exact3. Candidate4/5 builds must not be uploaded as normally selectable certified publication artifacts. This supplies capability-first ordering for item18; item17 alone activates default5 after consumer readiness.
